metadata.description: Engineering-ritual skills and role agents that complement aiwf, the planning kernel at github.com/23min/ai-workflow-v2.

plugins.name: aiwf-extensions
plugins.description: Milestone-lifecycle skills (start, wrap, release, track, record-decision) and four role agents (planner, builder, reviewer, deployer). Calls aiwf — install only if you use aiwf as your planning kernel.

plugins.name: wf-rituals
plugins.description: Repo-agnostic engineering rituals: patch (one-off branch + PR), tdd-cycle (red/green/refactor with branch-coverage discipline), review-code (review checklist), doc-lint (mechanical doc hygiene). No coupling to aiwf — works on any repo.
